# `/scheduled-searches` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /scheduled-searches/v1

`createScheduledSearchV1` — Create a new scheduled search

Creates a new scheduled search.

- Scopes: sp:scheduled-search:manage
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 201: scheduledsearch

### GET /scheduled-searches/v1

`listScheduledSearchV1` — List scheduled searches

Returns a list of scheduled searches.

- Scopes: sp:scheduled-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: owner.id: eq; savedSearchId: eq — e.g. `savedSearchId eq "6cc0945d-9eeb-4948-9033-72d066e1153e"`
- Returns 200: array of scheduledsearch

### PUT /scheduled-searches/v1/{id}

`updateScheduledSearchV1` — Update an existing scheduled search

Updates an existing scheduled search.

- Scopes: sp:scheduled-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Body (application/json): scheduledsearch
- Returns 200: scheduledsearch

### GET /scheduled-searches/v1/{id}

`getScheduledSearchV1` — Get a scheduled search

Returns the specified scheduled search.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Returns 200: scheduledsearch

### DELETE /scheduled-searches/v1/{id}

`deleteScheduledSearchV1` — Delete a scheduled search

Deletes the specified scheduled search.

- Scopes: sp:scheduled-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /scheduled-searches/v1/{id}/unsubscribe

`unsubscribeScheduledSearchV1` — Unsubscribe a recipient from scheduled search

Unsubscribes a recipient from the specified scheduled search.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Body (application/json): typedreference
- Returns 204: no body
